Layla Ibrahim | Junior DevOps/SRE Engineer | NexGen Solutions  
*Building resilient systems at the intersection of code and infrastructure*  

As a DevOps/SRE engineer, I own end-to-end CI/CD pipelines that slash deployment times by 40% and slash manual errors. My Linux expertise keeps servers running at 99.95% uptime, while Prometheus/Grafana dashboards give our team real-time visibility into system health. Terraform automates infrastructure at scale, cutting provisioning time by 60% and slashing cloud costs by 25% through optimized resource allocation.  

I thrive in fast-paced startups, where my Python scripts streamline repetitive tasks, and my GitHub Actions workflows ensure code quality without slowing down release cycles. ArgoCD powers seamless GitOps deployments, and Jenkins bridges gaps between dev and ops. My focus? Making complex systems simple, reliable, and future-proof.  

Looking to grow with teams that value impact over jargon. Let’s build something that lasts.
